name: Going To Hell
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that hell is a real and eternal place of punishment for the unrighteous, described as everlasting fire where both soul and body can be destroyed (Matthew 10:28; Matthew 25:41, 46). Jesus warns believers to avoid sin even at great personal cost, emphasizing that it is better to lose a part of the body than to be cast into unquenchable fire (Mark 9:43, 48). The parable of the rich man in Luke 16:19 further illustrates the reality of judgment after death, underscoring the eternal separation from God for those who reject Him. This study also considers the sensitive question of children going to hell, affirming the need to understand God's justice alongside His mercy.
